lines: gd8 stateful suite (devnet-8 state, BAL on, 341 tests, newPayload time, noise about 1%): account_access takes 54% of the time, ether_transfers_onchain_receivers 32%, ext_account_query_warm 7%
#25339 mem-batch shards vs main 17822a558f: 3.4% faster in total, ether_transfers 5.9% faster (26.0 to 23.7 s), account_access 1.4% faster

Within noise: self-loop workers exit after commit (0.8%), BranchCache skips an identical fill (0.9%), 3 trie BAL warmup workers instead of 6 (0%), code buffer kept across reader rebinds (0.1%), BAL read slots kept to the next block (0.6% on sstore/sload)

Slower: READ_AHEAD_BAL_CODE=true 51%; Gosched after each exec-loop publish 2.0% (ether_transfers 6.5%); state root computed ahead from the BAL for tip blocks 0.9% (ether_transfers 4.4%), its fold competes with exec for the 6 CPUs

Where the time goes: account_access runs serial cold CALLs, 21% of CPU reads code (decompress, then one cache copy); ether_transfers ends with a ~280 ms CPU-bound commitment fold after exec; sstore_bloated waits on I/O; ext_account_query_warm is EVM-bound
